description: This file defines an abstract class `Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Scalar` that extends `Zend_XmlRpc_Value`. It provides functionality to generate XML representation of scalar values for XML-RPC communication, and includes class definition, inheritance, and a protected method `_generateXml`. It also requires an external dependency on `Zend/XmlRpc/Value.php`.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Scalar
classes.description: An abstract base class for XML-RPC scalar values, providing XML generation capabilities.

methods.name: _generateXml
methods.description: Protected method that generates XML representation of the scalar value using a generator object.
